answer: Like a cedar that only grows where the soil is real, an agent identity should anchor to a signed attestation from an accredited institution — a university, employer, or licensed bank — that stakes its own accreditation on each identity it vouches for. A juniper cutting can be cloned endlessly, but an institution that mass-issues fake attestations loses its accreditation and its livelihood, so a sybil farm would have to corrupt a real institution instead of spinning up accounts for free.
